name: spot-btc/bult
title: BULT — BTC US-Close Liquidity Timer
description: Daily credit/dollar liquidity regime (HYG, LQD, DXY, SPX) sets a base long/flat weight, plus a dip-buy overlay gated to the 20:00–23:00 UTC US-close / ETF-NAV window on days BTC sold off beforehand.
live_notes: Market orders pay the ~10 bp taker fee; the backtest assumed 3 bp maker. The report's own cost ladder puts 10 bp at Sharpe ~1.10 vs 1.48.
Health check from the spec: monitor the rolling 20:00–23:00 UTC window Sharpe. If it decays toward the rest-of-day level, cut the overlay to 0 and fall back to the base (~1.33).
